plainLanguage: Bila lawful authority, mtu anayefanya, kuandaa, kusaidia au kupanga war au warlike undertaking na/au dhidi ya mtu au kundi ndani ya United Republic anaweza kuwajibika chini ya section 43.
meaning: Section 43 criminalises specified participation in a war or warlike undertaking where lawful authority is absent. Liability is not confined to personally carrying it on; preparation, aid and devising are expressly included.
keyPoints: Absence of lawful authority is expressly required.
Covers carrying on and preparing a war or warlike undertaking.
Also covers aiding or devising it.
The undertaking may be with, for, by or against persons or groups in the United Republic.
Penalty stated is imprisonment for life.

legalTerms.meaning: Mamlaka ya kisheria inayoweza kuondoa element ya 'without lawful authority' iliyowekwa na section.
Neno la statutory linalohitaji kutumika kwa facts na authoritative interpretation, si kila mgogoro au vurugu.

examples.title: Preparation
examples.scenario: Madai yanahusu maandalizi ya undertaking badala ya undertaking iliyokwisha kuanza.
examples.analysis: Section 43 expressly includes preparation, lakini prosecution bado lazima ithibitishe kuwa undertaking ni ya aina inayofunikwa na section na hakuna lawful authority.

history.summary: The R.E. 2022 text records Act No. 2 of 1970 in relation to this provision.

expertPerspectives.label: Mtazamo A
expertPerspectives.view: The verbs in the provision deliberately reach beyond direct execution to preparation, aid and devising.

expertPerspectives.label: Mtazamo B
expertPerspectives.view: 'Warlike undertaking' should not be replaced by a looser label; the proved facts must meet the statutory concept.

debateQuestion: Facts zinazodaiwa zinaonyesha war or warlike undertaking na participation ipi kati ya verbs zilizoorodheshwa na section 43?
disclaimer: Ufafanuzi huu si maandishi rasmi ya sheria.
